---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? (e.g. "I keep losing track of which green lot each roast came from")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why this one?

## Use case

Describe a concrete workflow this would enable. Who benefits? (you? a colleague? all micro-roasteries?)

## Mockups / examples

Sketches, screenshots from other software, or links are all welcome.

## Priority

How important is this to your work? (nice-to-have / would-be-helpful / blocking-my-workflow)
